name: Your Company
tagline: A mobile welder at your door within the hour, anywhere in Tashkent

listing.description: A website for a mobile welding and small metal-repair service: a job tracker on the first screen, a “from” price list with icons and a call button always to hand.

seo.title: Your Company — mobile welder in Tashkent within an hour
seo.description: A welder with a generator arrives within 60 minutes to fix gates, weld pipes or build a canopy or stairs. Price agreed before work starts, 1-year guarantee on welds.
seo.answer: Your Company is a mobile welding service in Tashkent: a welder with a generator arrives in about 60 minutes, daily from 7:00 to 23:00. Call-out 80,000 UZS, gate repair from 250,000 UZS, pipe welding from 150,000 UZS. The price is agreed before work starts, with a 1-year guarantee on welds. Phone +998 71 200-07-03.

sections.title: A welder with you within the hour
sections.subtitle: A gate hinge broke, a pipe is leaking, you need a canopy before the rain — the welder comes with his own generator and rods. We price it from a photo before setting off.

sections.label: Prices
sections.title: What we can weld today
sections.intro: Prices are “from”; we confirm the exact sum from a photo before setting off.

items.title: Gate and wicket repair
items.text: Hinges, bolts, sagging leaves and cracked frames.

items.title: Pipe welding
items.text: Heating, water and gas pipes — gas only with a licence and pressure test.

items.title: Carport canopy
items.text: A box-section frame with polycarbonate in one or two days.

items.title: Stairs to the first floor
items.text: A steel frame ready for timber or tile treads.

items.title: Late-night emergency
items.text: A burst pipe or broken gate lock after 23:00.

items.title: Photo
items.text: Send a photo on Telegram or describe the problem by phone.

items.title: Price
items.text: We name the price before setting off — no “we’ll see when we get there”.

items.title: Call-out
items.text: The nearest welder sets off with a generator and steel.

items.title: Work and payment
items.text: We weld, grind and paint the seam. You pay after checking it.

sections.label: About us
sections.title: Welders who turn up on time
sections.text: Your Company is twelve welders in their own vans with generators across Tashkent. The dispatcher sends the nearest one, so an hour is our normal time, not a promise. Every welder works in proper gear and clears away the slag afterwards.

items.quote: The gates stopped closing at eight in the evening. The welder was here at nine; by ten it all worked.
items.author: Aziz

items.quote: They priced it from a photo and did not raise it on site. That is rare.
items.author: Lola

items.q: Do you need power on site?
items.a: No, every welder carries a petrol generator.
Yes, common box section, angle and sheet are in the van; anything else we buy on the way at yard prices.
Only licensed welders, with a pressure test afterwards; those jobs are done in the daytime.
One year on welds: if a seam fails, we re-weld it free.

sections.label: Call-out
sections.title: Describe the problem — we will give a price and arrival time
sections.text: Daily 7:00–23:00, emergencies only at night. Base at 22 Lutfiy St, Uchtepa.
